name: supplier-risk-intelligence-demo
description: An explainable supplier-risk demo combining XGBoost, evidence retrieval and observable APIs.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,API,RISK -c cyan,green,yellow "pnpm --filter @srm/web dev" "pnpm --filter @srm/api dev" "python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --app-dir services/risk-engine --port 8000"
scripts.lint: eslint apps/api/src apps/api/tests && pnpm -r --if-present lint && pnpm lint:risk
scripts.verify: pnpm model:verify && pnpm retrieval:verify && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
